citation: Ng et al. (2003), Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 100, 4748–4753
preparation: Maternal plasma sampled before delivery and at a paired postpartum time, at term (38–42 weeks). The two-hour and 24-hour comparisons used different groups.
limit: The denominator is sampled women. The concentration changes refer to plasma samples, and neither the time of release nor the survival of individual RNA molecules was measured.
